# we6jbo Dark Souls Text/Schematic Simulator

Repository: https://github.com/we6jbo/dark-souls-remastered-1.0.3-we6jbo-save
Public site: https://we6jbo.github.io/dark-souls-remastered-1.0.3-we6jbo-save/
Research findings: https://github.com/we6jbo/dark-souls-remastered-1.0.3-we6jbo-save/blob/main/research.md
Research-book notes: https://github.com/we6jbo/dark-souls-remastered-1.0.3-we6jbo-save/blob/main/research_book.md
Research request: https://we6jbo.github.io/dark-souls-remastered-1.0.3-we6jbo-save/research-ai-request.json
Main site: https://j03.page/

Purpose: Human-directed and AI-assisted Dark Souls text/schematic simulation plus software-reliability research.

Capabilities:
- AI Player with local Ollama and controlled advisory escalation
- TTYREC/asciinema spectator communication
- closed-caption Dark Souls guidance analysis
- embedded DSR video playback/geometry/recovery telemetry
- local map intelligence and coordinate-training concepts
- Docker-gated KOSMOS reliability research
- safe Git whitelist and GitHub Pages publication
- two-computer update/state and peer-verification architecture
- privacy-filtered computer performance observability

Privacy boundary: no credentials, private network identifiers, third-party map images, raw video frames, or simulator source.
